steps: Deployed the program to devnet (upgrade authority is the lab wallet)
Created a 6-decimal SWORN mint (DwHZekzd…) with the lab wallet as mint authority
initialize with min_identity_bond=3_000_000 and max_identity_bond=5_000_000 (protocol-config A39izGrY…, insurance-pool 2G6iBe6V…)
Fetched protocol_config: admin is the lab wallet, sworn_mint matches, bonds 3000000/5000000, governance_phase=0
Minted 5 SWORN (6 decimals) to the lab wallet ATA 8j29fgaV…
setup_bond_vault created the v1 bond-vault token PDA
migrate_bond_vault created bond-vault-v2 (same SWORN mint) and closed the v1 vault
register_agent with bond_amount=3_000_000 created identity 3dNYaVyn…; identity_bond=3000000, matured=false
evidence.functional_evidence: initialize landed and protocol_config was read back; setup_bond_vault and migrate_bond_vault created the v2 bond vault; register_agent locked a 3 SWORN identity bond and the AgentIdentity account was read back; a second register_agent was rejected.
evidence.ui_check: The hosted page is the generic IDL console (connect Phantom or Solflare on devnet, then submit initialize or later instructions). It was not driven in headless Chromium in this run; the same initialize instruction was sent with the lab wallet through the IDL client in tests/devnet/trust-protocol.mjs.

limitations: Contract, dispute and insurance instructions were not sent. The below-min bond path was attempted with a different signer but used the lab ATA, so that failure is not a clean InvalidBondAmount proof. Bonds are locked in the vault.
standard_limitation: Practice-environment evidence records specified behaviour under stated conditions. It is not a security audit, a guarantee of current availability or an endorsement of production use.
